en.s: The Battle of Yinshan (Chinese: 陰山之戰; pinyin: Yīnshān zhī zhàn) was fought on 27 March 630 near the Yin Mountains, close to the city of Dingxiang (定襄, in modern Hohhot, Inner Mongolia). Emperor Taizong (598–649) commissioned the famed Tang military officer Li Jing (李靖, 571–649), along with Li Shiji, Wei Xiaojie, Li Daozong, Chai Shao (柴紹), and Xue Wanche (薛萬徹) to attack forces under the command of Illig Qaghan, leader of the Eastern Turkic Khaganate, a nomadic confederation of Turkic peoples based in Inner Asia.

zh.s: 630年3月27日，唐军与东突厥在阴山附近、靠近定襄的地方交战，地点在今内蒙古呼和浩特一带。唐太宗（598—649年）命名将李靖（571—649年），与李世勣、韦孝节、李道宗、柴绍和薛万彻共同进攻颉利可汗的军队。颉利可汗统治的东突厥汗国，是以亚洲内陆为活动中心的突厥游牧部族联盟。

en.s: The Battle of the Salnitsa was the main battle in the final phase of the great campaign of a coalition of Kievan Rus' princes against the Polovtsians in March 1111 on the Salnica River. In this battle, the Polovtsian army was completely defeated by Rus' princes led by Grand Duke Svyatopolk Izyaslavich of Kiev, Prince Davyd Sviatoslavich of Chernigov and Prince Vladimir Monomakh southern Pereyaslavl.

zh.s: 1111年3月，基辅罗斯诸侯联盟在萨尔尼察河战役中与波洛韦茨人交战。这是该联盟远征的最后阶段中的主战役。基辅大公斯维亚托波尔克一世、切尔尼戈夫王公达维德·斯维亚托斯拉维奇和南佩列亚斯拉夫尔王公弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫率军，彻底击败波洛韦茨军队。

en.t: Pope Clement V imposes excommunication and interdiction on Venice, and a general prohibition of all commercial intercourse with Venice, which had seized Ferrara, a papal fiefdom
en.s: Pope Clement V (Latin: Clemens V; born Bertrand de Got, died 20 April 1314) was head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 1305 until his death. He is remembered for suppressing the order of the Knights Templar and allowing the execution of many of its members. A Frenchman by birth, Clement moved the Papacy from Rome to Avignon, ushering in the period known as the Avignon Papacy.

zh.t: 教宗克勉五世对威尼斯实施绝罚和禁令，并全面禁止与威尼斯进行商业往来；威尼斯此前占领了教宗封地费拉拉
zh.s: 教宗克勉五世（拉丁语：Clemens V；本名贝特朗·德·戈特，1314年4月20日去世）自1305年起担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者，直至去世。他因镇压圣殿骑士团并允许处决其许多成员而为人所知。他出生于法国，在任期间将教廷从罗马迁至阿维尼翁，由此开启了所谓的“阿维尼翁教廷时期”。

en.s: Pope John XXII (Latin: Ioannes XXII, Italian: Giovanni XXII, French: Jean XXII; 1244 – 4 December 1334), born Jacques Duèze (or d'Euse), was head of the Catholic Church from 7 August 1316 to his death, in December 1334. He was the second and longest-reigning Avignon Pope, elected by the Conclave of Cardinals, which was assembled in Lyon.

zh.t: 教宗若望二十二世颁布《在主的田野中》，谴责迈斯特·埃克哈特的部分著作为异端
zh.s: 教宗若望二十二世（拉丁语：Ioannes XXII；意大利语：Giovanni XXII；法语：Jean XXII；1244年—1334年12月4日）本名雅克·迪埃兹（或称d'Euse），于1316年8月7日起担任天主教会领袖，直至1334年12月去世。他是第二位阿维尼翁教宗，也是任期最长的一位；他由在里昂集会的枢机团选出。

en.t: Charles I becomes King of England, Scotland and Ireland as well as claiming the title King of France
en.s: Charles I (19 November 1600 – 30 January 1649) was King of England, Scotland, and Ireland from 27 March 1625 until his execution in 1649. Charles was born into the House of Stuart as the second son of King James VI of Scotland. After his father inherited the English throne in 1603, he moved to England, where he spent much of the rest of his life.

zh.t: 查理一世继位为英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰国王，并宣称法国国王头衔
zh.s: 查理一世（1600年11月19日—1649年1月30日）自1625年3月27日起担任英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰国王，直至1649年被处决。他出身斯图亚特王室，是苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世的次子。1603年，父亲继承英格兰王位后，查理移居英格兰，并在那里度过了此后大部分人生。

en.s: A series of mainshocks struck Calabria on March 27–28 and June 9, 1638. The first three earthquakes had moment magnitudes estimated to be Mw 6.6–7.1. On June 9, another mainshock estimated at Mw 6.7 struck the same region, causing further damage and casualties. The four earthquakes resulted in as many as 30,000 fatalities.

en.s: The siege of the Fortress of São Filipe, was a battle fought from 27 March 1641 to 4 March 1642 as part of the Portuguese Restoration War, near Angra, Azores, between Spanish and Portuguese over the control of the fort of São Filipe. After 11 months of intense fighting the Portuguese were victorious and the Spanish garrison was defeated with very heavy losses.

zh.s: 葡萄牙复国战争期间，1641年3月27日至1642年3月4日，葡萄牙和西班牙军队在亚速尔群岛安格拉附近围绕圣菲利佩堡控制权交战。圣菲利佩堡围城战持续11个月，葡萄牙最终获胜，西班牙守军惨败，伤亡惨重。

en.s: The Battle of Preßnitz (German: Schlacht bei Preßnitz) was a military engagement fought on 27 March [O.S. 17 March] 1641 during the Thirty Years' War. In the battle, Imperial troops under Octavio Piccolomini defeated the Swedish army under Field Marshal Johan Baner.

zh.s: 三十年战争期间，帝国军队与瑞典军队于1641年3月27日（儒略历3月17日）在普雷斯尼茨交战。奥塔维奥·皮科洛米尼率领的帝国军队击败了约翰·巴纳尔元帅统率的瑞典军队。

en.s: The Raid on Salmon Falls (March 27, 1690) captured and destroyed the English settlement of Salmon Falls (present-day Berwick, Maine) during King William's War. It involved Joseph-François Hertel de la Fresnière, his son Jean-Baptiste Hertel de Rouville and Norridgewock Abnaki chief Wahowa.

zh.s: 威廉王战争期间，法军及其盟军于1690年3月27日攻占并摧毁了英格兰萨蒙瀑布殖民地（今缅因州贝里克）。参与突袭的有约瑟夫-弗朗索瓦·埃尔特尔·德·拉·弗雷斯尼耶、其子让-巴蒂斯特·埃尔特尔·德·鲁维尔，以及诺里奇沃克阿贝纳基族首领瓦霍瓦。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Bull was a French attack on the British-held Fort Bull on 27 March 1756, early in the French and Indian War. The fort was built to defend a portion of the waterway connecting Albany, New York to Lake Ontario via the Mohawk River. Lt. Gaspard-Joseph Chaussegros de Léry led his command consisting of forces from the Troupes de la Marine, Canadien militia, and Indian allies on an attack against Fort Bull on 27 March 1756. Shielded by trees they sneaked up to within 100 yards (91 m) of the fort. Léry ordered a charge at the fort with bayonets.

zh.s: 1756年3月27日，法军袭击英军控制的布尔堡，时值法国与印第安人战争初期。该堡用于保卫纽约州奥尔巴尼经莫霍克河通往安大略湖的一段水路。加斯帕尔-约瑟夫·肖斯格罗·德·莱里中尉率领法国海军所属陆战部队、加拿大民兵及原住民盟友发动进攻。他们借树木掩护，潜行至距堡垒仅100码（91米）处，随后莱里下令持刺刀冲锋。

en.t: Accession of Charles Watson-Wentworth, 2nd Marquess of Rockingham
en.s: Charles Watson-Wentworth, 2nd Marquess of Rockingham (13 May 1730 – 1 July 1782) was a British Whig statesman and magnate, most notable for his two brief terms of less than a year each as Prime Minister of Great Britain, some 16 years apart. His second term was ended by his death from influenza at the age of 52.

zh.t: 查尔斯·沃森-文特沃斯继任罗金厄姆侯爵，成为第二代侯爵
zh.s: 第二代罗金厄姆侯爵查尔斯·沃森-文特沃斯（1730年5月13日—1782年7月1日）是英国辉格党政治家和权贵。他最著名的是两度出任大不列颠首相，每次任期都不足一年，两段任期相隔约16年。第二个任期因他52岁时死于流感而结束。

en.s: The Battle of Mallavelly (also spelled Malvilly or Malavalli) was fought on 27 March 1799 between forces of the British East India Company and the Kingdom of Mysore during the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War. The British forces, led by General George Harris and Colonel Arthur Wellesley, drove the Mysorean force of Tipu Sultan from a defensive position designed to impede the British force's progress toward Mysore's capital, Seringapatam.

zh.s: 第四次英迈战争期间，英国东印度公司军队与迈索尔王国军队于1799年3月27日在马拉维利交战。乔治·哈里斯将军和阿瑟·韦尔斯利上校率领英军，击退了蒂普苏丹的迈索尔军队。迈索尔军队原占据防御阵地，意在阻止英军向迈索尔首府塞林伽巴丹推进。

en.s: The Battle of Ciudad Real was fought on 27 March 1809 and resulted in a French victory under General Sebastiani against the Spanish under General Conde de Cartojal. French 4th Corps (with attached Polish division under general Valance) had to cross the bridge over the Guadiana River which was defended by the Spanish corps of Count Urbina Cartaojal. Polish lancers of the Legion of the Vistula under colonel Jan Konopka charged through the bridge taking it by surprise, then outflanked Spanish infantry and attacked it from behind as the main French and Polish forces crossed the bridge, and attacked the Spanish front lines.

zh.s: 1809年3月27日，塞巴斯蒂亚尼将军率领的法军在雷阿尔城战役中击败卡托哈尔伯爵将军指挥的西班牙军。法军第四军及配属的瓦朗斯将军所部波兰师，需要渡过瓜迪亚纳河上的一座桥，而桥梁由乌尔维纳·卡托哈尔伯爵的西班牙军团把守。扬·科诺普卡上校率维斯瓦军团的波兰枪骑兵突然冲过桥梁，夺取桥头，随后绕至西班牙步兵侧后方发起攻击。与此同时，法波联军主力过桥，进攻西班牙军正面阵地。

en.s: The Battle of Anholt (25–27 March 1811) was a successful British military operation under the command of James Wilkes Maurice against the Danish-held island of Anholt under the command of Jørgen Conrad de Falsen, taking place during the Gunboat War, a conflict between the United Kingdom and Denmark-Norway that was part of the wider Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 安霍尔特战役于1811年3月25日至27日进行，是英国在炮艇战争期间发动的一次成功军事行动。詹姆斯·威尔克斯·莫里斯率军攻打由丹麦控制的安霍尔特岛；丹麦守军由约根·康拉德·德·法尔森指挥。炮艇战争是英国与丹麦-挪威之间冲突的一部分，也属于更广泛的拿破仑战争。

en.s: The Battle of Horseshoe Bend (also known as Tehopeka, Tohopeka, Cholocco Litabixbee, or The Horseshoe), was fought during the War of 1812 in the Mississippi Territory, now central Alabama. On March 27, 1814, United States forces and Indian allies under Major General Andrew Jackson defeated the Red Sticks, a part of the Creek Indian tribe who opposed American expansion, effectively ending the Creek War.

zh.s: 马蹄湾战役发生在1812年战争期间的密西西比领地，也就是今天的阿拉巴马州中部。此役也称Tehopeka、Tohopeka、Cholocco Litabixbee或The Horseshoe之战。1814年3月27日，安德鲁·杰克逊少将指挥美军及原住民盟军，击败了反对美国扩张的克里克族红棍派，克里克战争由此基本结束。

en.s: In the early hours of March 27, 1814, the British ship HMS Hebrus caught the French ship Étoile near Jobourg, Normandy. After more than two hours of fighting, Étoile struck her colors and surrendered.

zh.t: 若布尔海战：埃托瓦尔号投降
zh.s: 1814年3月27日凌晨，英国“赫布勒斯”号在诺曼底若布尔附近追上法国“埃托瓦尔”号。两舰交战两个多小时后，“埃托瓦尔”号降旗投降。
zh.n: 这场海战跨越3月26日至27日；此条记录的是27日凌晨的追击、交战和投降。

Despite the protests for clemency by General José de Urrea, the massacre was reluctantly carried out by Lt.

zh.s: 1836年3月27日，得克萨斯革命期间，墨西哥军队在戈利亚德镇杀害了得克萨斯共和国的战俘及其指挥官詹姆斯·范宁。命令来自墨西哥总统兼将军安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳。何塞·德·乌雷亚将军曾请求宽恕这些战俘，但屠杀仍被不情愿地执行。原文在交代执行者的军衔时中断。

en.s: The Goliad Campaign was the failed 1836 Mexican offensive to retake the Texas Gulf Coast during the Texas Revolution. Mexican troops under the command of General José de Urrea ambushed Groups of Texians in the Mexican province of Texas, known as Mexican Texas, in a series of clashes in February and March. When Mexico transitioned to a centralized government in 1835, supporters of federalism took up arms.

zh.s: 1836年3月27日，墨西哥军队在今天美国得克萨斯州的戈利亚德处决大批被俘的得克萨斯士兵。戈利亚德战役是得克萨斯革命期间墨西哥为夺回得克萨斯湾岸发动的失败攻势，持续于2月至3月；何塞·德·乌雷亚将军率军在数次交战中伏击得克萨斯人。当时得克萨斯仍是墨西哥的一省，1835年墨西哥转向中央集权后，联邦派支持者起而反抗。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 27 March 1869 to elect the president for a three-year term. They were the first and only elections conducted under the 1869 Constitution. Following the 1868 coup d'état that overthrew José María Castro Madriz before the end of his constitutional term, former president Jesús Jiménez Zamora returned to power as provisional president.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1869年3月27日举行大选，选出任期三年的总统。这是依据1869年宪法举行的第一次、也是唯一一次选举。1868年的政变曾在何塞·玛丽亚·卡斯特罗·马德里斯的法定任期结束前将其推翻，前总统赫苏斯·希门尼斯·萨莫拉随后以临时总统身份重新掌权。

en.t: 1871 Scotland versus England rugby union match
en.s: The rugby union match played between Scotland and England on 27 March 1871 was the world's first international rugby match. It is also officially the first international rugby match in any rugby code. The match was played at Raeburn Place, Edinburgh in front of 4,000 spectators. Scotland won the match, scoring two tries and a goal to England's single try.

zh.t: 1871年苏格兰对英格兰橄榄球赛
zh.s: 苏格兰与英格兰于1871年3月27日举行的橄榄球赛，是世界上首场国际橄榄球比赛，也是所有橄榄球项目中公认的首场国际赛。比赛在爱丁堡雷伯恩球场举行，观众约4000人。苏格兰队凭借两次达阵和一次射门得分取胜，英格兰队仅有一次达阵。

en.s: The Battle of Turret Peak occurred March 27, 1873 in the Arizona Territory between the United States Army and a group of Yavapai and Tonto Apaches as part of Lieutenant Colonel George Crook's campaign to return the natives to reservations.

en.s: The Capture of Nam Định (27 March 1883), a confrontation between the French and the Vietnamese, was one of the early engagements of the Tonkin Campaign (1883–86). In a brief campaign in the last week of March 1883, Commandant Henri Rivière captured the citadel of Nam Định, the second-largest city in Tonkin, with a flotilla of gunboats and a battalion of marine infantry.

en.s: The 1896 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 9th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1896 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Ukraine on 27 March 1994, with a second round between 2 and 10 April. However, 112 seats were remained unfilled, and a succession of by-elections were required in July, August, November and December 1994 and more in December 1995 and April 1996. Three hundred (300) seats or two thirds (2/3) of the parliament were required to be filled for the next convocation. In what were the first elections held after Ukraine broke away from the Soviet Union, the Communist Party of Ukraine emerged as the largest party in the Verkhovna Rada, winning 86 of the 338 seats decided in the first two rounds.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iraq on 27 March 2000. The election was contested by 522 candidates, including 25 women. Thirty MPs were appointed to represent Iraqi Kurdistan. Whilst there were a number of candidates, all independent candidates were nominally loyal to the Ba'ath Party, and the rest of the candidates were party members. The Ba'ath Party won 165 of the 250 seats. Of the 85 remaining seats, 55 were independents, and 30 were appointed by the government to represent the northern Kurdish areas of Sulaymaniyah, Arbil and Dohuk, where no elections took place, and which had been outwith Iraqi government control following the Gulf War.

en.s: At approximately 1:22 p.m. CT on March 27, 2000, an explosion and fire responsible for 1 death and 71 injuries occurred at Phillips Petroleum's Houston Chemical Complex at 1400 Jefferson Road, Pasadena, Texas 77506. The fire produced huge plumes of black smoke that spread over the heavily industrialized Houston Ship Channel and neighboring residential areas. The explosion occurred at the K-Resin facility and involved a type of plastic made with butadiene. At the time of the explosion, the tank was out of service for cleaning and had no pressure or temperature gauges that would have provided the workers with an alert to the approaching crisis.

en.s: The Baden-Württemberg state election 2011 was held on 27 March 2011 to elect members to Baden-Württemberg's State diet, the Landtag of Baden-Württemberg in Stuttgart. en.s: On 27 March 2015, Al-Shabaab militants launched an attack on the Makka al-Mukarama hotel in Mogadishu, Somalia. The siege ended a few hours later on 28 March, after a special forces unit of the Somali Armed Forces stormed the premises, recaptured it, and killed all five of the attackers. According to the Ministry of Information, around 20 people died during the standoff, including the perpetrators, security forces, hotel security guards and some civilians, with around 28 wounded. The special forces also rescued more than 50 hotel guests.

en.s: On 27 March 2016, Easter Sunday, at least 75 people were killed and over 340 injured in a suicide bombing that hit the main entrance of Gulshan-e-Iqbal Park, one of the largest parks in Lahore, Pakistan. The attack targeted Christians who were celebrating Easter. Of the 75 dead, 14 were identified as Christians and the rest (61) as Muslims. The majority of victims were women and children. Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, a group affiliated with the Pakistani Taliban, claimed responsibility for the attack. The attack led to worldwide condemnation and national mourning throughout Pakistan. Pakistan also launched a widespread counter-terrorism operation in South Punjab, arresting more than 200 people.

zh.s: 2022年3月27日夜间，受卢旺达支持的M23武装在刚果（金）北基伍省发起新一轮进攻，开启持续多年的军事行动。该组织早在2021年11月就攻击过刚果政府军和联合国刚果稳定团，夺取北基伍省恩迪扎、昌祖和鲁尼奥尼的军事阵地。

en.s: On 27 March 2023, a fire occurred at an immigration detention center in Ciudad Juárez, Chihuahua, Mexico, near the border with the United States. The fire killed 40 people and left 27 others seriously injured. According to Vice interviewees, prison officials demanded bribes from migrants to release them and avoid deportation. The fire was allegedly started by inmates when they set fire to their mattresses to protest their detention conditions and impending deportation.

zh.t: 华雷斯城移民拘留中心火灾
zh.s: 2023年3月27日，墨西哥奇瓦瓦州华雷斯城一处移民拘留中心发生火灾。该中心靠近美国边境，火灾造成40人死亡、27人重伤。据接受Vice采访的人士称，拘留人员向移民索要贿赂，称付款后便可获释并免遭遣返。据称，被拘留者为抗议拘留条件和即将被遣返的处境，点燃床垫，引发了大火。

en.s: On March 27, 2023, a mass shooting occurred at The Covenant School, a Presbyterian Church in America parochial elementary school in the Green Hills neighborhood of Nashville, Tennessee, United States, when 28-year-old Aiden Hale (born Audrey Elizabeth Hale), a transgender man and former student of the school, killed three nine‑year‑old children and three adults before officer Rex Engelbert and detective Michael Collazo, members of the Metropolitan Nashville Police Department (MNPD) shot and killed him.

zh.s: 2023年3月27日，美国田纳西州纳什维尔格林希尔斯社区的圣约学校发生大规模枪击案。该校是美洲长老会附属小学。28岁的跨性别男性艾登·黑尔，出生时名为奥德丽·伊丽莎白·黑尔，曾就读于该校。他枪杀了三名九岁儿童和三名成年人，随后被纳什维尔都会警察局警员雷克斯·恩格尔伯特及警探迈克尔·科拉索击毙。

en.s: The 2024 Maltese presidential election took place on 27 March 2024. Members of the Parliament of Malta voted in an indirect election to elect the next President of Malta with former parliament speaker Myriam Spiteri Debono being the only nominee. Spiteri Debono's nomination was supported by both the governing Labour Party and opposition Nationalist Party and she was elected unanimously in a 75–0 vote out of 79 deputies as Malta's third female and third Gozitan president.

zh.s: 2024年3月27日，马耳他议会通过间接选举选出新总统。前议长米丽娅姆·斯皮泰里·德博诺是唯一被提名者，同时获得执政工党和反对党国民党支持。在总共79名议员的议会中，她以75票赞成、零票反对一致当选，成为马耳他第三位女性总统，也是第三位来自戈佐岛的总统。
